items.title: Vibe coding is changing how musicians customize their gear
items.excerpt: Engadget reports how musicians and hobbyist developers are using AI chatbots and coding agents to build their own DAW plugins and hack hardware, lowering the cost of making production tools; it cites developers such as Anukari's Evan Mezeske.

items.title: Inside the First AI Music Awards, a Chaotic Evening Attempting to Normalize Tech-Assisted Tunes
items.excerpt: Variety reports from the Sonic Intelligence Academy's first AI Music Awards in Los Angeles, where AI artist Xania Monet took three of the four top categories as AI creators tried to move past legal threats toward genre legitimacy.

items.title: AI DJs Completely Kill My Groove
items.excerpt: WIRED's hands-on critique of YouTube Music's 'Beyond the Beat' and Spotify's AI DJ finds the synthetic hosts' banter and fabricated song trivia undermine playlist listening.

items.title: 예술과 AI, 상생의 길을 더듬는 치열한 실험... 김명옥의 [지금, 서울 AI 산조]
items.excerpt: 전통 산조에 AI를 접목한 김명옥의 공연 '지금, 서울 AI 산조'를 다룬 리뷰로, 국악 무대에서 AI와 예술의 상생 가능성과 한계를 짚는다.

items.title: Gustavo Cerati's Children Slam Remastered Video Facing AI Backlash: 'We Weren't Consulted'
items.excerpt: Gustavo Cerati's children say they were not consulted about the remastered 'Me Quedo Aquí' video, which fans accuse of AI-altered visuals, adding to the estate-consent debate around AI remasters.

items.title: Russia's Propaganda Machine Deploys Pro-War AI Songs
items.excerpt: A Ukrainian nonprofit, Terrecon, found nearly 1,000 AI-generated pro-war songs on Russian streaming services, a new genre surfacing in listeners' feeds to stoke patriotic sentiment.

items.title: Akai Opens MPC 3 To Vibe Coding With Latest Update
items.excerpt: Akai's free MIT-licensed MPC Plugin SDK lets developers build synths and effects that run on MPC hardware, with documentation for using coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to generate the C++ from natural-language descriptions.

items.title: AI music tools as sketchbooks for electronic artists
items.excerpt: Independent electronic producers describe using AI music tools to sketch ideas and test arrangements and moods while keeping authorship and their final sound their own.

items.title: 뮤니버스뮤직퍼블리싱, 2027년 글로벌 송라이팅 캠프 확대 및 AI 음악 플랫폼 'MUZZK' 사업화 본격 추진
items.excerpt: 뮤니버스뮤직퍼블리싱이 2027년 서울·도쿄·LA·베를린 송라이팅 캠프를 확대하고 AI 음악 플랫폼 MUZZK 상용화를 추진하며, 계약 체계 정비를 위해 법무법인 2곳을 선임한다.

items.title: 데뷔하자마자 인기몰이...삼성증권 AI 걸그룹 '루미나' 뮤직비디오 300만뷰 돌파
items.excerpt: 삼성증권이 노래·캐릭터·영상을 모두 AI로 만든 가상 걸그룹 '루미나'의 뮤직비디오가 300만 뷰를 넘었고, 후속곡과 교육 영상도 계획 중이다.

items.title: Stolen (Not Super) Intelligence: Why Congress Must Stop Big AI From Ripping Off Creators (Guest Column)
items.excerpt: Rep. Jerrold Nadler argues in Billboard that Congress must act to stop AI companies training on creators' work, including music, without consent or compensation.

items.title: Several Unreleased Morgan Wallen Songs Have Recently Appeared On TikTok – But Are They Leaks Or AI?
items.excerpt: Purported unreleased Morgan Wallen songs circulating on TikTok have fans debating whether they are genuine leaks or AI voice-cloned fakes.

items.title: Reservoir Expands Its Suno and Anthropic Suits, Seeking $450M
items.excerpt: Reservoir amended its copyright and DMCA lawsuits against Suno and Anthropic to cover more than 2,500 songs combined, with sought damages now approaching $450 million.

items.title: Backlash Already Rumbles Against Spotify's Upcoming Remix Tool
items.excerpt: Spotify's upcoming AI remix tool is drawing criticism from listeners and artists questioning fairness to artists and the ethics of its AI training.

items.title: The 'Blue Wave' Could Change the Rules for Music AI
items.excerpt: After the US midterm 'Blue Wave', DMN maps how a new Congress could move AI music reforms on artist rights, copyright and compensation.

items.title: You can now vibe code plugins for your MPC with the help of Akai's official SDK
items.excerpt: Akai's latest MPC, MPC Sample and Force updates ship an official SDK so users can build custom synths and effects for standalone hardware, explicitly pitched as vibe-codable with AI coding assistants.

items.title: 'An affront to any songwriter': Nick Cave on AI song-generating platforms
items.excerpt: Nick Cave calls AI song generators 'our final, most soul-destroying humiliation' and an affront to songwriters who earned the right to create a song.

items.title: Ex-bandmates Dr Dre and Ice Cube clash over the use of AI
items.excerpt: On Ice Cube's new podcast, Dr Dre called AI 'a whole new level of creativity' producers must adopt or be left behind; Ice Cube pushed back.

items.title: Highlights, concerns, and trends from Game Sound Con 2026
items.excerpt: MusicTech's report from the game music and sound conference, where generative AI in game audio and scoring was a central concern and trend.

items.title: Carmine Appice On Using AI To Create Cactus Music Videos
items.excerpt: Rock drummer Carmine Appice explains how AI video is driving the music videos for Cactus's recent albums.

items.title: Logic Pro 13 gets touch right, but stumbles on "intelligent assistant"
items.excerpt: CDM's hands-on finds Logic Pro 13's touch upgrades strong but its AI 'intelligent assistant' that opens plugins, creates tracks and adjusts levels on command falls short.

items.title: Evaluating AI Musical Creativity: A Quantitative Multi-Dimensional Framework Based on Value, Novelty, and Surprise
items.excerpt: A framework that operationalizes Boden's value, novelty and surprise to quantitatively evaluate the creativity of AI-generated music.

items.title: Music Inpainting With Similarity-Guided Latent Diffusion
items.excerpt: SimDPS retrieves contextually similar segments from a recording and uses them to guide a diffusion model to replace large missing or damaged sections of music audio.

items.title: AI로 선율 입힌 셰익스피어詩…용호성 前차관, 첫 정규앨범 발표
items.excerpt: AI를 활용한 음악을 선보여 온 용호성 전 문체부 차관이 예명 '닥터 드래곤'으로 셰익스피어 시에 AI로 선율을 입힌 첫 정규앨범을 냈다.
